purpose: Make the standalone Havenwild Atlas Mapper preload the known Havenwild atlas/sheet universe as indexed cards while textures remain lazy-loaded. This is the standalone proof surface that will later mirror into Ember.

standaloneAuthority.pcc: Havenwild internal PCC remains the build/gate/apply authority
standaloneAuthority.emberMirror: Generic contracts and proven patterns are mirrored from the Havenwild GitHub repository into Ember later; this repository remains standalone for now.

mappedSheetRecord.meaning: A sheet or tile checkmark means mapping metadata exists. It does not mean the runtime has published or certified the asset yet.

nextImplementation: family filters and virtualized sheet browsing
